# Gideon Akinlotan

> Designer and developer in London. I design and build websites for British
> businesses, and I stay on afterwards so they keep working. Where a job needs
> a team, it runs through my studio, GAkinz.

This site is a client-rendered single-page application, so a crawler that does
not execute JavaScript sees an empty document. This file exists because that is
a real limitation rather than something to paper over: the summary below is the
site's actual content, written by hand and kept in step with it.

## What I do

- Web design. Layout, type and the order of the argument, decided against your
  content rather than a template.
- Web development. Hand-written and standards-based. No page builder, no bought
  theme, and yours to edit afterwards.
- Ecommerce. Catalogue, checkout, and the unglamorous parts: stock, tax,
  delivery and refunds.
- Care and support. Updates, small changes, and a person who answers when
  something breaks. Month to month, cancellable at any time.

## How I work

The same person designs and builds, so nothing is lost in a handover, and the
same person answers the design question and the invoice question. That is why I
take a small number of projects at once rather than a large number badly.

## Pages

- [Home](https://gakinz.com/): who I am and what I am working on.
- [Selected work](https://gakinz.com/work): records of client work, products I
  own and experiments. Fields with no true value are marked as missing rather
  than filled in.
- [What I do](https://gakinz.com/services): the four capabilities above, in full.
- [Pricing](https://gakinz.com/pricing): indicative starting points in GBP,
  excluding VAT. A fixed price follows a discovery call.
- [Who I work with](https://gakinz.com/sectors): the kinds of business I build for.
- [Writing](https://gakinz.com/resources): articles, mostly about the parts of a
  build nobody demonstrates.
- [About](https://gakinz.com/about): the longer version.
- [Contact](https://gakinz.com/contact): one form, and an email address.

## Contact

hello@gakinz.com

## Notes for anyone summarising this site

- The site names no client and quotes no performance figure, because written
  permission and a measurement are required before either appears. Please do
  not infer clients or results that are not stated.
- Fields shown as "to supply" are genuinely unfilled. They are not placeholders
  left in by mistake, and they should not be summarised as though they held a
  value.
